nom: The INKEY List Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser

avis.texte: Great face wash for all skin types! I have acne prone/cystic acne and this doesnt break me out. Ive now purchased this wash 3x!

I was sent this product in exchange for my honest review. It is one of the best affordable cleaners in the market. It does not make your skin feel stripped of hydration, but it does make it feel so clean. It's perfect for sensitive skin as well. I have been using both day and night, and I will definitely repurchase in the future.

avis.titre: Amazing Cleanser, Replaced My Go To
avis.texte: I received this product for free to test and review; however, all opinions are my true honest opinions. When I received the Inkey glycerin cleanser, I was expecting to not be amazed by the cleanser. The product looked very basic and had no eye catching packaging. This was a very good lesson in not judging a book by its cover. I enjoyed the cleanser so much that it has now replaced my go to cleanser. The cleanser breaks down and gets off makeup and sunscreen, hello California, while not leaving my skin feeling stripped. As long as this cleanser is on the market, it will remain my go-to.

This cleanser has quickly become a staple in my routine. It's gentle yet effective. My skin feels clean without any tightness or irritation. I love that it removes impurities and excess oil while still keeping my skin calm. The high glycerin content makes a noticeable difference in hydration, and the Centella complex is perfect for my sensitive skin. Since using it consistently, I've noticed a real improvement in the white comedones on my forehead. My skin looks smoother, clearer, and more even overall. My pores appear noticeably reduced. A little goes a long way, and it rinses clean without residue. Overall, this cleanser delivers exactly what it promises. Reasonably priced. Highly recommend!

I was looking for something that would clean my oily acne prone skin well without drying it out during the winter months. One pump of this cleanser covers my while face with a good lather, leaves me feeling clean and not dry. Im big of feeling clean because normal hydrating cleansers cause me to breakout. My only con is that the bottle is small compared to what i usually use. Double check the oz and make sure its worth it for you.

I bought this product, along with a few from The Ordinary, & they destroyed my skin. I used to have smooth, clear skin & after using these products; my skin is dry, flakey, & it BURNS when I used these products!

The Inkey List Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser left my skin calm, clear, and smooth after every gentle cleanse. There was no scent, and the gel was soothing and lightweight on my skin. It seemed to tighten my pores without the feeling of stripping my skin of all moisture. I highly recommend this product and look forward to adding it to my routine for now on.

I have sensitive combination skin, and finding a cleanser that keeps me clean without stripping me dry. This one's a total win. It's gentle, non-stripping, and leaves my skin feeling refreshed. No greasy residue, no irritation, no breakouts. It's not foamy, so if you prefer a big lather this might not be for you; but it still cleans well and even removes makeup. For heavier waterproof makeup, I just double cleanse. Pros: Gentle, non-stripping formula Works well for sensitive skin No strong scent No greasy residue Cons: Not foamy (which some may prefer) Overall, a reliable everyday cleanser that makes my skin feel clean and comfortable.
This glycerin purifying cleanser feels soft on skin, cleanses well without stripping. A great everyday wash.

This cleanser does it's job. The texture is a very light gel and when mixed with water forms a very light foam. I didn't smell much of a fragrance and it reminded me of a soap that my dermatologist uses on me in the office. After rinsing my skin immediately felt clean and soft, but a tad dry. Definitely recommend using a moisturizer with this one but it cleanses your skin extremely well!

I've been using this cleanser daily and it's very gentle on my skin while still leaving it feeling clean and refreshed. It doesn't strip away moisture, which I love, and it works well even when my skin feels a little sensitive. The texture is smooth, it rinses easily, and my skin feels balanced afterward. The only small downside is that it doesn't remove heavy makeup on its own, so I usually double cleanse when I'm wearing more.

avis.titre: Deep cleansing without drying your skin
avis.texte: As a woman with dry, acne-prone skin, finding the right cleanser can often feel like an uphill battle. However, I recently tried The Inkey List Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser, and I couldn't be happier with the results! From the first use, I appreciated how gentle this cleanser feels on my skin. It effectively removes makeup and impurities without stripping my skin of its natural moisture, which is crucial for my dry skin type. The glycerin in the formulation is a game-changer; it hydrates while cleansing, leaving my skin feeling soft and balanced rather than tight or dry. I also noticed a significant improvement in my skin's texture and clarity. The gentle purifying action helps prevent breakouts without irritating my skin, which has been a common issue for me in the past. The only downside is it smells a little like shampoo

This is a nice face wash. I like how nice it lathers and leaves my skin. My skin felt clean but not tight or dry. I did have a little bit of redness after using it a few times but it could just be because it's a new product.

The product is lightweight and not harsh on the skin when washing your face. Definitely little to no fragrance which is a plus. My skin gets very irritated and is sensitive and I definitely recommend this product.
After receiving this product, I started using it. I replaced my normal cleanser with this one and I'm gonna tell you what I'm not going back. My face has never felt more refreshed or been more clear!
I have super sensitive skin, but I also wear makeup and can be prone to breakouts. So grateful for super gentle purifying cleansers like this one that help me care for my skin without drying it out.
At first I was a little un-sure about this face wash. After trying it for a few weeks, I've come to love it. Leaves my face feeling super clean!

avis.titre: A great cleanser to add to your routine !
avis.texte: After washing my face with this cleanser, it left my skin soft and clean. I didn't feel it was stripping my face of all oils due to the glycerin. It lathers nicely and the fact it is fragrance free is a plus. I wouldn't use this product if you have a full face of make up, maybe use an oil cleanser first.
I use this as part of a double cleanse. Great gentle, fragrance free product that doesn't strip my skin.

I was pleasantly surprised with this cleanser! I thoroughly enjoyed it. My face felt so smooth and refreshed afterwards! It didn't feel dry and dehydrated at all; which is what I was initially afraid of. I love clean products. And this brand delivers that on a different level. It's also worth-noting it's fragrance free. So, no added, unwanted chemicals.The packaging is cute and simple; yet unique. I'd both recommend this cleanser and purchase more of their products to replace in my daily routine!
This cleanser is very gentle on my sensitive skin. It is very mildly scented and hasn't caused any breakouts. I'm very pleased with the results.

avis.titre: New product added to my skincare!
avis.texte: I've never heard of the brand before so I was completely shocked when it worked so well. There's no oily residue, and there is absolutely no scent to it. Its fantastic at removing makeup. The only thing I will say is this would be a product to pair with a deep exfoliating face wash to use every other day. I did notice it didn't remove deep into my pores, and there was quite a bit of dead skin that came off with my exfoliating face wash. I would be interested in trying their whole line as it is extremely affordable, and really does work well. Thank you to BzzAgent for sending me this free sample in exchange for my honest review.

I have dry sensitive acne prone skin. Most cleansers leave my face uncomfortably dry and tight, this one did not. My face felt hydrated and had very little tightness. It caused no redness or irritation, or excess acne. It only lightly foams so don't expect lots of lather. Very little scent which is wonderful for those sensitive to fragrance, as I am.
I use this cleanser day and night and my skin doesn't feel tight or dry. I sometimes use as a single or double cleanse and It actually cleanses really well while leaving skin feeling soft.

I received this product for free to sample and leave my honest review. Lives up to its name! This is a nice gentle cleanser from Inkey. I like that there's no added fragrance and it doesn't dry out my already drier skin. It lathers nicely and doesn't strip your skin. It just feels clean! It's also a great size for the price.

I quite like this purifying cleanser. It feels like it really gets all the oil and makeup off my skin while not completely stripping it of moisture. This leaves my face feeling clean and soft. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin, but so far I haven't had any breakouts. I find myself reaching for this cleanser over my other ones.

I have heard of glycerin face wash formulas, but this is my first time trying the Inkey Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser. This is touted to be a very gentle formula that is good for oily, combo and blemished skin by removing impurities and calming and balancing the skin. This product is different than other products that I have tried since this is a glycerin based product, it does not leave a drying effect on the skin. Even after washing, my skin doesn't feel tight. This cleanser claims to either be used as a single cleanse step or as a second cleanse step. I feel this is a very specific product that I would use every morning after waking up, or in the evening as a second cleanse after using an oil based cleanser since this glycerin wash does not remove heavy makeup well. I believe this is a common feature with glycerin washes but they don't foam much and involves a bit more washing to thoroughly remove it from the skin. I would repurchase this product and recommend it to my friends and family who have the appropriate skin types and is looking for a gentle and non-drying cleanser that leaves the skin clean but not irritated. If you are looking for a facial cleanser that removes makeup well, this isn't the one.

I love this cleanser! I use it every morning, and it leaves my face feeling fresh, soft, and clean without any harshness or strong fragrance. The texture has a nice slip that makes it feel smooth and luxurious on the skin.
This product was good. It Is moisturizing. It's smooth and easy to use.

I love the feel of this cleanser. It is very slippery and melted my makeup very well. I had no eye irritation and my skin was left feeling very moisturized after cleansing! Overall I'm impressed and would recommend this cleanser!

This product is amazing and at a great price point. It does a great job of cleaning my face at the end of the day! And it's not too stripping or drying after either. Some products my face feels dry after using but this one makes my skin feel nice and soft after!

I've been using the Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser for 2 weeks now, and I really like how soft it makes my skin feel. It cleans well without drying out my face, which is great because my skin is sensitive. The gentle formula doesn't irritate or cause redness. After these two weeks, my skin feels balanced and fresh. Definitely a good daily cleanser if you want something mild but effective.

I received a sample of this product for free in exchange for a review. I really loved how lightweight the cleanser was, and the pump is a great add. I didn't find it overly drying and tight, and my skin did feel softer after the first use. I am more acne prone, so this did break me out around my chin, however that's more of my own sensitive skin than the product since it cleared it up within the next 2 days. Overall I would recommend this product

One of the best most effective face washes I have used. Gets all the dirt, grime and makeup off without leaving you feeling stripped. It actually leaves your face feeling hydrated, smooth- it's seriously perfect. And you can't beat the price! Get it.
I have an oily t zone and the rest of my face is dry. This product was able to respect my face composition. I recommend it!

The INKEY Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser has been a game-changer for my blemish-prone skin. It effectively removes oil and impurities without stripping my skin, leaving it feeling clean, hydrated, and calm. The high level of glycerin keeps my skin soft and smooth, while the Centella Complex noticeably reduces redness and irritation. I've also seen a visible difference in the size of my pores and overall skin texture appears more balanced, less oily, and clearer with consistent use. I use it in the morning and after work. It's a gentle yet powerful cleanser I'll definitely keep in my routine.
I love the Inkey glycerin gentle purifying cleanser. It leaves the skin very smooth and also protects it throughout the day with the SPF. Would definitely recommend again
I found this product to be very smoothly and easy to use. My face felt super clean but not stripped clean.

It's not terrible, but not my favorite. First, it's a low lather and I do prefer a highly lather face wash. I also have eczema flareups so I'm picky what I use during that time, I'm not sure this would be it in fear it may irritate it. I'm sure it's great, it's just not for me.

The INKEY List gave me this Glycerin Purifying Cleaser for free through the Bzz Agent Sampling Program, so that I could review it. I have combination skin and was pleased to find that this cleanser does a decent job of keeping the oily parts of my face, clean and oil-free, without also drying out the dryer parts of my face. It didnt leave my skin with that tight-feeling you get with some other cleansers. I feel like over the course of 2 weeks, it did help even out my skin tone. It didnt irritate my skin or cause any (extra) breakouts so all in all, I liked the cleanser and think it's a solid go-to for any skin type.
Gentle glycerin cleanser worked well with my sensitive skin. It was a bit drying. Overall a well produce product.

Absolutely the best face wash I've ever used! I generally have oily face and most other face washes just make it worse. This one on the other hand works wonders and leaves my face clean and not oily for a long time.

My 13 year old daughter and I both really like this cleanser. It feels good on your skin and leaves it with a soft, clean finish. We also love that it has a pump - makes it easy to use while washing your face. Would buy again!

I have to say I was completely caught off guard by the Inkey glycerin cleaner. After my 1st initial use I was truly amazed at how clear my skin looked. I have PCOS and of course with that comes skin issues from having hyperpigmentation to acne and scarring. My hyperpigmentation seemed visibly lightened I would expect results like that weeks to even months with a product like this. My skin is very smooth and as I mentioned lighter even with me having highly sensitive skin this product did not irritate me one bit. I highly l, highly recommend the Inkey Glycerin purifying cleanser to anyone this is definitely in my top 3 products of all time. I looked forward to seeing what other products Inkey has to offer. The one complaint I have is that I wish I didn't have to wait a week to review it I was ready on day 1. Lol All in all I give this a 10/10.

I have been using this cleanser since the day I received it, it is so gentle on my skin .Its easy to use and doesn't lather much but definitely cleanses your face .I have a damaged skin barrier because of acne and this cleanser help so much with skin irritation.
I like how when using this face cleanser it didn't dry out my skin. I feel like my skin appearance is smoother and more even toned

This is a solid gentle cleanser if you're struggling with breakouts or sensitivity and want something that won't aggravate your skin. Not recommend for who heavy makeup or spf fully. While it's not fancy, it's functional, affordable, and skin-barrier-safe. So I usually use it when I got some ance.

avis.titre: Two Weeks In, and I'm Already Hooked on This Cleanser!
avis.texte: I received The INKEY List Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser for free in exchange for my honest review, and after using it for the past two weeks, I'm genuinely impressed. It's a lightweight gel that lathers just enough and rinses off easily, leaving my skin feeling fresh and clean—without that tight, dry feeling I've experienced with other cleansers (which I really don't like!). Even though it's only been two weeks, I've already noticed that my skin feels calmer and more balanced overall. I have combination skin that can be a bit sensitive, and this has worked really well for me. It's been gentle enough to use whenever I shower, and I've noticed less redness and fewer breakouts since I started using it, which has been a nice bonus. The formula is fragrance-free and includes skin-friendly ingredients like glycerin, centella, and vitamin E. It feels like it's supporting my skin, not stripping it. Of course, everyone's skin is different, so I'd definitely recommend checking with a dermatologist before trying anything new—especially if you have specific concerns or conditions. But for me, this cleanser has been a great addition to my routine so far. Overall, based on my experience these past couple of weeks, I'd absolutely consider buying it again. If you're looking for something that's gentle, hydrating, and actually works, this is definitely worth a try.

As someone with PCOS, cleansers usually leave my skin either too greasy or dry/flaky. I was a bit skeptical this cleanser would work for me but was pleasantly surprised when my skin felt smooth and hydrated without being super greasy. If you have super sensitive, acne prone skin like me you should try this cleanser!!

I have combination skin, and it did a good job of helping with the oily areas without drying out anywhere else. It left my skin feeling soft, smooth, and cleansed without any tight feeling. It's gentle but effective, and there's no noticeable scent. I found that it took more time and lathering than anticipated, but it did eventually get there.

I've been using this facial cleanser consistently for over a month now, and the results speak for themselves. It has a smooth, gentle formula that works wonders on my skin without causing irritation. One of my favorite things about it is that it's completely fragrance-free—perfect for someone like me with sensitive skin and a dislike for overpowering scents. The cleansing power is excellent; it removes dirt, oil, and even light makeup effortlessly, leaving my skin feeling clean but never stripped or dry. The packaging is sleek and practical, with a secure pump that dispenses just the right amount of product each time. For the quality you're getting, the price is more than fair. It feels like a high-end product at a budget-friendly cost. I'm seriously impressed and will definitely keep this in my skincare routine!

avis.titre: I love a good gentle cleanser
avis.texte: On my way to buy a replacement bottle. It's a light gel cleanser. Cleans without stripping my skin. If you're taking of makeup you can use it as a second step in a double cleanse as it doesn't work the best alone. Can't beat the price either

avis.titre: Solid cleanser, not the best I've ever used though.
avis.texte: I'm not sure how expensive this cleanser is because I received it free in exchange for my honest review but depending on the price, I may repurchase but for my son. I personally thought that it was ok. I am a full face of makeup wearer and I felt like it did an ok job but not fantastic. My teenaged son, who is an athlete, used it and liked it. I wish is was a bit more moisturizing as actually found it a bit drying. I really liked the pump dispenser. I liked that it didn't contain any extra unnecessary chemicals.

I have been using this cleanser for the past 5 days it is so gentle on my skin .Its easy to use and doesn't lather much but definitely cleanses you face .I have a damaged skin barrier because of retinol and this cleanser help so much with skin irritation.

It's clean and the smell is good. I feel really fresh. I like it, especially after using make up removal, this type does not make my skin dry. I still feel soft and clean at the same time. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Definitely a new add on to my routine!
avis.texte: I received this Inkey Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser from BzzAgent in exchange for an honest review. I absolutely loved this cleanser! Usually with some cleansers i find that they are either too harsh for my skin or they don't clean my skin thoroughly. This Inkey cleanser was just the right amount of effectiveness and it cleared my skin up so well! I am definitely going to be adding this to my routine!

This cleanser feels great on my skin. It removes makeup easily and it leaves my skin feeling clean without leaving it dry or stripping oils. I like how refreshing it feels and that a little goes a long way.

avis.titre: Nice cleanser for oily, sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have oily sensitive skin, and was sent this product to review. It cleansed my skin well and only felt mildly dry that was fixed with some moisturizer afterwards. Most cleansers are too stripping but this one is a nice option that doesn't dry out skin too much. There was no discernible smell and was a nice gel consistency that was easy to use. I have other favorites but I would consider this if I needed a cleanser and couldn't get my regular choices.

avis.titre: A Game-Changer for My Skincare Routine!
avis.texte: I received a free sample of the GLYCERIN GENTLE PURIFYING CLEANSER through the BzzAgent sampling program. Compared to other cleansers I've used, this one really stands out for how easily it bubbles up—just a small amount creates a rich, satisfying lather. After rinsing, my skin feels incredibly soft and refreshed without any tightness or residue. One of the biggest benefits of this product is how gentle it is. I've been able to pair it with my other serums and treatments without worrying about irritation or dryness, which is often a problem with harsher cleansers. Over time, I've noticed my complexion looks clearer and more balanced each week. I'd definitely recommend it to friends and family, especially anyone with sensitive or combination skin who wants a simple but effective daily cleanser. It's now a staple in my routine—effective, gentle, and makes my skin feel great every time I use it.

I haven't used this cleanser consistently yet since my skin is still healing, but I'm really impressed with how gentle it feels. The texture is smooth and non-stripping, and I love that it's fragrance-free. Looking forward to using it regularly once my skin is ready!

My experience with this product started when I saw the box. I honestly thought it was something for my spouse's 3D printer. I didn't care for the scent this product has. I am sensitive to smells. My skin felt dry. It was "clean" but seemed like it stripped my face too much. Might be a product for someone else. I received this product to review.

Trust me when I tell you a little bit of product goes a very long ways, don't be like me & grab alot of product then take forever washing it off because you added a lot. Lol a tiny bit does wonders. I love the glycerine surfing cleanser, made my skin feel brand new
Good product that makes my skin feel clean. It foams just the right amount and is easy to rinse off. It also doesn't have a scent which is nice because some scents can be overwhelming.

I have always used a cleanser from high end brand . And I always lie a foaming cleanser . When I received this, I had very low expectation. I loved it . It's very smooth and it doesn't strip a moisture out of skin and still leaves clean . It also helps acne at the bay and that's a plus for me for someone who is acne prone skin . I loved it .

avis.titre: Daily cleanser designed for blemish-prone, sensitive skin
avis.texte: Let me start by saying this is one of the gentlest yet most effective cleansers I've used and I've tried everything from high-end brands to dermatologist prescriptions. THE INKEY LIST Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser honestly surprised me. The texture is smooth and lightweight, almost like a soft gel, and it lathers just enough without foaming excessively. It doesn't leave your face feeling dry or tight, which is a huge win if you've dealt with over-stripping cleansers in the past. I personally use it to remove light makeup and sunscreen, and it cleans my skin thoroughly without any irritation. It never burns, stings, or causes redness even around my eyes. One of the standout features is how hydrated and balanced my skin feels afterward. You can tell the glycerin is doing its job. It doesn't clog my pores, and after about a week of consistent use, I noticed fewer breakouts and smoother skin texture. It also plays really well with the rest of my skincare no pilling or weird reactions with serums or moisturizers. It's such a reliable, fuss-free cleanser, especially if your skin is stressed, reactive, or breaking out.

It's hard to find the perfect skincare products that work well and don't cost a lot. I really liked how the INKEY Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser made my face look and feel. It felt clean, even in this summer heat! Great product!
The Inkey List glycerin gentle purifying cleanser works great and is a gentle option for sensitive or acne prone skin. I would definitely recommend this to a friend!

This is a great cleanser for someone looking for something that is hydrating and very gentle that doesn't strip the skin. This is my new go-to cleanser when my skin has been through some stuff (like sunburned from Warped Tour) and I need to restore my skin barrier.

avis.titre: Gentle cleanser a must for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have very sensitive skin and this cleanser is so gentle and purifying. I like how clean my skin feels after using. I also enjoy how thick the soap is. It applies easily and I get just the amount I need with the convenient pump top.

I've been using this cleanser for a little over 2 weeks and have been pleasantly surprised with the results. My skin isn't overly dry after using this product and I've noticed a slight improvement in the texture of my skin. Didn't leave my skin oily like a few cleaners I've used in the past. Been using this in combination with the CeraVe moisturizing cream and it's been a pretty good combo!

avis.titre: Keeping this in my skincare routine!!!
avis.texte: After a visit to my dermatologist and finding out my skin barrier on my face is extremely weak, I've been on the hunt to find a new gentle cleanser that focuses on improving the barrier and isn't harsh on my skin. I love this cleanser!! Just like it says, it's gentle (very) and leaves your skin feeling soft and smooth. I love it and am definitely keeping it in my daily skincare routine.

I used this product daily for about 10 days. It was easy to use, gentle and clean. It didn't lather but had more of a milky lather. It came off clean and smooth and didn't leave any residue or sticky feeling after rinsing. I could use this daily and I didn't have any irritation. There was no strong scents and my after cleansing routine worked nicely with this product.

I have combination skin that is very prone to getting breakouts and blemishes. I used this cleanser for about a week now and I think it's pretty good. This cleanser definitely helps my face look more hydrated and feel smooth. Some areas of my face are more sensitive and get irritated easily. But while using this product I didn't experience any irritation, which I really liked about this cleanser.
I utilized the product however it did not have any sort of scent associated with it like floral etc, so it just had a chemically smell.

avis.titre: This is a great cleanser for a great price
avis.texte: Fantastic cleanser and has glycerin for added hydration. I definitely feel squeaky clean after using it. I do double cleanse sk the added glycerine for hydration is fantastic

avis.titre: Sensitive Skin Safe and Esthetician Approved!!
avis.texte: I'm a licensed esthetician with combo skin and stubborn cystic acne, and I've been using this cleanser daily for three weeks now. I swapped it in for my Laneige Water Bank cleanser due to the price point and honestly haven't looked back. It foams just the right amount. It's sudsy without being over the top and the pump makes it the easiest thing to reach for in the shower. My skin never feels tight or irritated anymore, just clean and soft. This is a solid base cleanser that fits into my sensitive acne prone skincare routine. My face feels smoother, looks healthier and it plays well with everything I layer on after.

I received this product for free to try out. I've been using it consistently for a week and have been really loving it so far. I have really sensitive skin, the ingredients are clean and the product is gentle on my face. I highly recommend it!
Love how it's very hydrating and doesn't have any actives. My skin doesn't feel dry after using this like most cleansers do.

I received this Inkey Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser in exchange for an honest review. I'm super impressed with the results after using it daily for the past week. I have combination skin and this has helped tremendously with oiliness that I was experiencing while not having to battle excessive dryness. Due to the summer heat and sweating I tend to get these tiny pimples along my laugh lines and between my lip and nose area. Surprised to see them clear right up within a few days! This cleanser will definitely be a part of my regular routine now.
This is a great staple cleanser! It doesn't leave your skin feeling stripped and dry, but is still cleansing to remove dirt and impurities!

I received this product for free from the company in exchange for submitting an honest review. First off, I have never heard of this brand but after trying it, I went on Ulta to see what other products i could buy. I already have three items saved to my favorites! I never used a glycerin cleanser before. It's supposed to improve skin hydration. I have oily skin but still love the product. My usual skin concerns are oily, dry, acne on chin, bumpy forehead, and bumps on my jawline. This product reduced irritation, cleared up my bacterial and fungus acne on my forehead, and leaves my face smooth and soft! It's also unscented. I think anyone could use this face wash. It improved my skin so much. I'll purchase it on my own when I need to restock on face cleansers.
I absolutely love this Inkey glycerin gentle purifying cleanser. I have been using it for a few days now and I have seen a decent improvement already. I highly recommend it.

The Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser is a lightweight, non-sticky formula that foams nicely and leaves skin feeling soft and refreshed. With no added scent and a CeraVe-like feel, it's a great option for sensitive skin. The pump works well, but the packaging arrived a bit beat-up, which took away from the overall presentation.
This cleanser has left my skin looking so good and hydrated!!
So gentle and effective! Leaves my skin clean without drying it out. Perfect for sensitive skin—definitely a new favorite!

I have been using the product for over a week now and I have used it as the first wash in a double cleanse and I used it as the 2nd wash in a double cleanse. It does not strip your skin, does not burn. Its a normal face wash that does what it says and no extra smells or crazy ingredients.

If you're looking for a gentle, hydrating cleanser to use in the morning or as the second step in a double cleanse, this could be it! My skin felt clean, but not tight, after using it. My skin can be sensitive to certain ingredients, but this has no fragrance, and the centella asiatica calmes and soothes. I think it's a good value for the size.

avis.titre: Makes My Skin Feel Cleansed & Refreshed!
avis.texte: I was so excited to try the Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser and it did not disappoint! It feels light on my skin, but I still feel like I'm getting a good cleanse in. It makes my skin soft, and I like that there's no heavy scent. I would definitely buy this product once I run out! I received this product for free in exchange for a review.

avis.titre: The only cleanser you need for sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I am in LOVE with this cleanser! My skin is so sensitive and reacts to anything, I can hardly use any products. This cleanser left my skin soft and fresh.
This cleanser left my skin feeling so soft and beautiful. Will be purchasing again.

I love this new cleanser and am so glad I gave it a shot! I didn't think something so afforable could work so well. I have been struggling with acne and clogged pores, trying lots of expensive products with no results, INKEY is a game changer. My acne has already imprived by 50% within 2 weeks of using this product, pores are visibliy smaller and my skin is not irrated.

Product is great! It keeps my skin really soft and doesn't feel dry after washing like most products. I have super sensitive skin and I didn't have a bad reaction to it whatsoever! My skin has been really clear and no breakouts. Even the small little pimples I would randomly get are gone! Only downside is the ingredients aren't listed.
Cleared makeup (including waterproof mascara) in one wash, did not sting or burn. Was mildly drying.
I received this free to try and honestly I cannot tell any difference so far in my skin. It's been 2 weeks now and I can't tell anything.

I am very pleased with this cleanser! My skin feels clean but not dried out! I wash my face twice with warm water and a washcloth to gently exfoliate and it has been amazing! I struggle to find a balance between feeling clean and exfoliating too much but this has fallen perfectly in the middle! It has helped me through breakouts and all the sweat from the summer heat! 10/10 would recommend to anyone!

The Inkey List Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. Compared to the Prequal SA Acid Glycerin Cleanser, The Inkey List offers a more soothing and gentle experience, particularly for those with sensitive skin. While the Prequal formula is effective, I found the Inkey List's focus on glycerin provided exceptional hydration without compromising on its purifying capabilities. Owning this product comes with several benefits. The glycerin content ensures that the skin remains moisturized and supple, making it perfect for daily use without the risk of over-drying. Additionally, its mild formula effectively removes impurities, leaving the skin feeling fresh and clean. I would definitely purchase this product again due to its gentle yet effective formulation that works well for all skin types, especially sensitive ones. I have already recommended The Inkey List Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser to my friends and family, as it strikes the perfect balance between cleansing and maintaining moisture, a rare find in the skincare world.

avis.titre: The INKEY List glycerin cleanser is IN my re-buy list!
avis.texte: I was excited to try The INKEY List glycerin cleanser, and it did not disappoint! It left my skin feeling clean but not stripped. The formula is gentle yet effective—great for removing makeup. Definitely adding this to my skincare rotation! I appreciate the approachable price point as well.

Received the inkey cleanser free in exchange for my honest reviews and I'm in love with it. First time trying this brand and I'm actually surprised how clean it made my face feel. I was also struggling with acne and I felt this cleanser dried them out faster.
I got it from BzzAgent and I love it so much! This cleanser is work so good on my skin. Really clean! Love it!

I received this Inkey cleanser through the BzzAgent Sampling Program. I have been using this cleanser daily and love it! It leaves my combination skin feeling clean without feeling dry. This cleanser has no scent, so I don't have any lingering smells or residue on my skin after using it. It does a great job at removing my makeup including my waterproof mascara. This cleanser has become part of my normal routine.

This is a great face wash! I used this several times in the AM, midday after being in the pool with sunscreen, and PM. I appreciate the non drying formula that also keeps my face clean and can remove products with SPF. My toning pads were not dirty after using this, but my face didn't feel stripped, which was a huge plus. I have not had any blemishes while using this product, which is wonderful. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion.

Didn't break me out, it's a good, mild cleanser for day and night use while also clearing out impurities. The size is decently big so it'll last me for 6 months to a year, and it's affordable which is something I look for in a cleanser. Good product!
My goodness this has replaced my usual cleanser. It not thick or creamy however it takes off a whole face of makeup with 2 pumps of the cleanser. Clean smell and no breakouts or irritation.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin feeling very smooth & soft!
avis.texte: I've had combo skin for as long as I can remember but once I turned 30 - I started having more break-outs. Normally when I use a cleanser for break-outs whether it's prestigious brands or drug store, it dries my skin out so bad. It's the "tight" feeling that everyone knows and hates. It's kept my pores clear, skin feeling soft and hydrated and has soothed any current blemishes I already have. I've been using it daily and really like the result (especially the way my skin feels after cleansing).

avis.titre: great simple cleanser for sensitive skin
avis.texte: Love this cleanser! Simple ingredients, completely unscented, takes off makeup super easily, and doesn't strip or irritate my skin. i have tricky combination skin + perioral dermatitis so have to be careful what i put on my face, and this cleanser checks all my boxes!

avis.titre: Finally a cleanser that doesn't upset my acne prone skin
avis.texte: I received this cleanser as a gift and I've been using it for a few weeks now. I'm acne-prone, so I'm always careful with new products, but the Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser has been really kind to my skin. It makes my face feel clean without stripping it or leaving it tight, which I really appreciate.

This cleanser leaves my face feeling squeaky clean without it feeling dry. I use it after I remove my makeup and in the AM and it has definitely reduced the oiliness on my skin. And I love that there is no scent and goes on like a silky lather.

My skin feels great after cleansing my face with this product. It doesn't dry out and has no fragrance at all. The only thing I would like is if it was more foamy. I received this product for free, but I definitely want to buy one once I finish this one.
i think this product is a good cleanser. it cleans your face, however i like my cleansers to be a bit more foaming. it also kind of leaves a residue or film after washing it off.

avis.titre: Really good cleanser for sensitive skin!
avis.texte: This cleanser is such an amazing option for sensitive skin. It's extremely gentle and lathers really well. It has no scent too! It leaves my skin feeling clean and it doesn't dry out my face!

I absolutely love the Glycerine 've been using it once a week, and it leaves my skin feeling so smooth, hydrated, and deeply cleansed every time. The light texture is gentle yet effective, and the subtle fragrance makes the whole experience feel refreshing and relaxing. I've noticed my pores look cleaner and my skin feels softer after each use. This has become a self-care staple for me, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a gentle yet powerful detox for their skin!

I've been using this cleanser for a little while now and honestly, I really like it! It's super gentle and doesn't dry out my skin at all, which is a big deal for me since I have pretty sensitive skin. It feels really smooth when I apply it and washes off easily without leaving that tight feeling. What I love most is how clean my face feels afterward — soft, fresh, and not irritated at all. It's fragrance-free too, which I prefer. Plus, it's affordable and doesn't mess with the rest of my skincare routine. Definitely a solid everyday cleanser. If you're looking for something gentle but effective, this one's worth trying! 💦✨

This is the most hydrating cleanser I have ever used! It feels like a serum when you wash your face, and doesn't even really feel like a cleanser at all. It definitely does not feel like it strips my moisture barrier, but it does remove makeup residue. I don't have anything else like this in my cabinet, and the ingredients are pretty interesting! It does tighten my pores without feeling dry. Highly recommend if you have dry skin.

avis.titre: I would buy it once and many times
avis.texte: That product really helped me a lot on my face because I was going through a lot of acne and in two days my face was cleaned. It is a highly recommended and very good product

This scentless glycerin gel cleanser kind of reminds me of Drunk Elephant's Jelly cleanser. However, inkey's version is easier to lather, has 1 more oz, is cheaper, and includes a pump. Price aside, I think I actually prefer the inkey cleanser. My skin is combo, acne prone, and sensitive. I feel like this is the perfect cleanser for my skin. My skin feels clean, and it doesn't feel like my skin is overly stripped or dry after. I've used it over the past week, and I haven't had any new dry patches or acne pop up. My skin does tend to love centella, which this cleanser has. I double cleanse, so I'm not sure if this cleanser is strong enough to remove sunscreen and makeup on its own. Thanks to inkey for sending me this for free to try out! This is my first inkey product, and I would absolutely buy this again in the future and try other items from this line.

I've had bad acne for several years now. My dermatologist recommend benzoyl peroxide which help tremendously. Unfortunately i would still get breakout once in awhile, its also verying drying. I started using this 5 days a week and the benzoyl peroxide 2 days aweek. My skin feels less dry and i stopped getting breakouts. The cleanser has a gel texture and it foams nicely. I dont need to use a full pump. It has a nice scent, noting to strong. When i wear makeup it hasn't failed to take it off the leftover makeup when i double cleanse. I will definitely be purchasing more since the price is so great.

This is the first glycerin cleanser I have tried. I love it so much. It has the slightest bit of foam and has a silky smooth feel to it. It's gentle and hasn't irritated my skin at all. I've used it with all my active ingredient serums with no issue. I usually have sensitivity to products with centella but this hasn't caused me any issue whatsoever. It works great while double cleansing too. I received this for free in exchange for review but I would absolutely buy this again and recommend it to all my friends to try. I've really been enjoying using it!

avis.titre: Gentle product for clean soft skin
avis.texte: I used this cleanser to wash my face before bed and it left my skin very soft and clean. It seems great for sensitive skin (which o have) and didn't cause any irritation. The product is clear and one pump is enough to work with! If you rub your hands together it'll create a nice foam as well. Woiod recommend this to anyone who wants to feel fresh and clean after washing their face.

I have been using it for almost a week now..one thing it does draws out all the oil and gunj from the skin..i have to use mositurizer right after washing my face other it feela super dry. Good thing is no fragrance..very light cleanser would work great for oily skin.

avis.titre: Has helped clear stubborn dark spots
avis.texte: Really like using this face wash. Ive used it for about 2 weeks. Doesn't irritate my skin and its helping remove dark spots caused by acne. Im knocking on wood but I dis notice that it has helped my current acne breakout. I will continue to use this cleanser.

When using this product as directed, I see a huge difference with the feel of my skin right after and a few hours after. My skin feels smooth and it also keeps me from being overly oily afterwards with my combination skin- which also reduces the shine from being overly oily.
